description: This file defines a custom SwiftUI PreferenceKey for tracking view width, extends View with a modifier to detect width changes, and includes debug testing utilities for width reduction.

classes.name: ViewMetricsTesting
classes.description: A utility enum for testing width reduction logic in debug mode.

methods.name: reduceWidth
methods.description: A static method that computes the minimum width between the current and next width values, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: onWidthChange
methods.description: A View extension method that attaches a GeometryReader to observe and react to width changes.
